name: Kamio Kenji
source:
3rd year high school student & professional manga artist.
Hobby: Reading and drawing manga.
Although he hides it at school, he is a professional shojo manga artist with a serial in the weekly shojo manga magazine "Comic Charm".
His pen name is "Ijuuin Alice" (name can be changed).
He made his debut at the age of 13 and was said to be a genius at the time, but he has a tendency to be moody and has been on the decline recently. This is his fourth manga to be canceled.
He is passionate about drawing "all-round manga" that can be enjoyed by people of all ages and genders.
In order to get rid of the title of canceled manga artist, Chika makes him cross-dress, revealing his hidden face to readers and promoting him as a "beautiful girl manga artist".
If you enter the heroine's route, the content is different, but the protagonist's true identity becomes known nationwide due to events and TV programs in which Ijuuin Alice appears. When this happens, he is often slapped by some of the heroines.
